# GIF Studio — Video to GIF & Free GIF Tools (by CodeLove)

> Free browser-based GIF tools: convert video to GIF, GIF to MP4, compress GIFs, crop, and resize animations privately without uploads or watermarks.

## Tools
- [Video to GIF](https://videotogif.codelove.in/video-to-gif/): Convert MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV, WebM into smooth animated GIFs.
- [GIF to Video](https://videotogif.codelove.in/gif-to-video/): Convert animated GIFs to lightweight MP4 videos.
- [GIF Compressor](https://videotogif.codelove.in/gif-compressor/): Reduce GIF file size in-browser without losing animation quality.
- [GIF Resize](https://videotogif.codelove.in/gif-resize/) & [GIF Crop](https://videotogif.codelove.in/gif-crop/)
- [Video Compressor](https://videotogif.codelove.in/video-compressor/), [Video Crop](https://videotogif.codelove.in/video-crop/), [Video Resize](https://videotogif.codelove.in/video-resize/)

## Companion CodeLove Video Tools
- [Video Cut (Shorts Cutter)](https://videocut.codelove.in)
- [Free AI Video Maker](https://videomaker.codelove.in)
- [Video to Images](https://videotoimages.codelove.in)
